title: enform instance.started@1 event payload
description: The payload of an instance.started@1 event (#43, #177, #187, #192, #222, #256, S06, ADR 0014, FM-7, DF-2, DX-1, I4, I13). It names the instance that the event started, by the id that the client minted (DX-1, #187), and the flow slug it runs (#222, I4), so two flows with identical definitions do not collide. A start creates a private draft on the request form, the first step of the definition (ADR 0014, D1): it stamps the instance with its definition version (DF-2), names the starter as the only assignee of the request form (I13), records the values the form holds so far (FM-7) and routes nothing; `skipped` is empty, because the submit decides the route (WF-1, S05).

instanceId.description: The id that identifies the instance, minted by the client that started it (DX-1, #187). It is not the operation id: the operation id names one change, the instance id names the instance that the change acts on.

flow.description: The slug of the flow that the instance runs (#222, I4). It names the flow a read and a write authorize on, so two flows with identical definitions do not collide.

definitionVersion.description: The content hash of the definition version that the instance started on (DF-2).

currentStep.description: The key of the request form, the first step, that the draft sits on (ADR 0014, S06).

assignees.description: The starter, as the only assignee of the request form (ADR 0014, I13).

starter.description: The principal that started the instance (S06, AC-5).

skipped.description: Empty: a start routes nothing, so it skips nothing; the submit records the skipped steps (ADR 0014, S05).

queue.description: The Unroutable queue when every target of the first step resolved to nobody (I10, AS-5). It is absent when the step resolved to at least one member.

outbox.description: The side effects of the start, committed with it (I2). An unroutable start carries the flow owner alert; a routed start carries none.

skippedStep.description: One step that the route skipped, and the condition that skipped it (S05, #192).

values.description: The values that the form holds: one field key to one JSON value (FM-7).

jsonValue.description: One JSON value: a string, number, boolean, null, array or object (FM-7, DF-1).

assignee.description: One resolved assignee of a step, with the membership snapshot that resolution produced (I13, AS-4).

target.description: A task recipient: exactly one kind, per AS-1. Dynamic targets are starter, field and manager-of.

outboxEntry.description: One side effect (SE-1): the connector operation, the connector, and its payload.
